hello_localhost.name: TODO: Everything
hello_localhost.description: It's 3AM. The coffee has geological layers and the Dream App is one README line long. Claude has opinions.

objectives.text: Talk to Claude — he's standing at the desk in your apartment
Collect 10 tokens — the glowing coins scattered around the apartment

morning_ritual.name: The Ritual Before The Work
morning_ritual.description: Nothing gets written until the ceremony is complete: the machine, the fridge, the long silent look at the plant. This is not procrastination. It has a running order, which makes it a process.

objectives.text: Run the coffee machine in the apartment kitchen (walk onto it, press [E])
Open the fridge beside it and confirm, again, exactly what is in it
Check the deprecated plant in the apartment's south-west corner

tiny_change.name: Just One Tiny Change
tiny_change.description: The client wants the button green. Two seconds of work, tops. The email is sitting on your desk. It is not two seconds of work.

objectives.text: Answer the client's 'tiny' email — use the 'Check client email' prompt on your desk

reproduce_locally.name: It Works Locally (That Is The Problem)
reproduce_locally.description: A red terminal on the east side of the room says /checkout is down. It is not down for you. It has never once been down for you. You are, technically, the only person for whom this product works.

objectives.text: Open the outage on the red terminal on the east side of the apartment
Read your own terminal on the east side of the room, which reports that everything is fine
Check the battlestation monitors in the north of the room for the graph nobody watches

install_node.name: Install Node (Five Minutes, Tops)
install_node.description: It's one command. It has never once been one command. The district is through the portal east of your apartment, and it has weather.

objectives.text: Take the east portal out of your apartment into the Dependency District
Defeat 2 Dependency Demons roaming the district
Find the crate in the district marked 'Recover package' and interact with it

pin_everything.name: Pin It All (Exact Versions, No Surprises)
pin_everything.description: Exact versions, no carets, no upgrades, ever. The build becomes perfectly reproducible and the security scanner becomes a scream. To be offered it, ask the Maintainer about security vulnerabilities, then about the install scripts, then about versions.

objectives.text: Read the package-lock.json in the Dependency District (walk onto it, press [E])
Defeat 2 Null References the old pinned versions were hiding — if the district is already clear, a portal round-trip restocks it

caret_gamble.name: The Caret Means 'Surprise Me'
caret_gamble.description: Take every upgrade the moment it lands. You will be first to the new features and first to the incident, and both of those count as being first. To be offered it, ask the Maintainer about security vulnerabilities, then about the install scripts, then about versions.

objectives.text: Inspect the node_modules drift in the Dependency District (walk onto it, press [E])
Defeat 3 Dependency Demons the minor release brought with it — only 2 roam at a time, so the district has to restock (leave through a portal and come back)

supply_chain.name: Eleven Lines Of Someone Else's Weekend
supply_chain.description: Before you build anything on top of this district, find out what is actually holding it up. Spoiler: one stranger, one lockfile, and a folder with its own gravity.

objectives.text: Read the package-lock.json in the Dependency District (walk onto it, press [E])
Inspect the node_modules drift in the same district
Pay respects at the left-pad marker, also in the Dependency District

stackoverflow_pilgrimage.name: Accepted Answer (2013)
stackoverflow_pilgrimage.description: Ancient wisdom: highly upvoted, deeply confident, four major versions out of date. The ruins lie east of the district.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the Dependency District into the Stack Overflow Ruins
Find the Stack Overflow Hermit in the ruins and consult him
Collect 25 cached tokens scattered through the ruins

own_answer.name: The Accepted Answer Is Yours (2019)
own_answer.description: You searched the error. The top answer has 340 upvotes and your name on it. It is wrong. It has been wrong for four years, and somebody has commented 'this saved me'.

objectives.text: Read the accepted-answer monument in the Stack Overflow Ruins (walk onto it, press [E])
Pay respects at the question gravestone in the west of the ruins
Defeat 2 Bugs your old answer is still causing out in the ruins — if the ruins are already clear, a portal round-trip restocks them

one_more_api_call.name: One More API Call
one_more_api_call.description: Just the one. Then you'll stop. You have said this before, out loud, to a person. The Bazaar is east of the Ruins and it is always Friday there.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the Stack Overflow Ruins into the API Bazaar
Haggle with the Shady API Reseller at his stall in the Bazaar
Survive 2 Rate Limiters patrolling the Bazaar

deprecation_friday.name: Deprecated, Effective Friday
deprecation_friday.description: Three tiers of the API you depend on are being retired, and it is always Friday in the Bazaar. The migration guide opens with 'most users will not need to change anything'. You are not most users.

objectives.text: Read the pricing board at the Bazaar stalls (walk onto it, press [E])
Check the Bazaar status page in the north-east (it is green; it is always green)
Survive 2 Rate Limiters already enforcing the new tier — if the stalls are already clear, a portal round-trip restocks them

cloud_migration.name: We Should Move To The Cloud
cloud_migration.description: Nobody can say why. Everyone agrees. Cloud. Something extremely expensive is drifting around that district and it knows your name.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the API Bazaar into the Cloud District
Endure the Cloud Salesperson's pitch (he is mid-district and cannot be reasoned with)
Defeat the $700 Cloud Bill — the huge one drifting through the district

unit_economics.name: Cost Per User: Negative (Let's Grow)
unit_economics.description: Every signup costs more in inference than it earns back. The dashboard is beautiful. The invoice has a line item called 'Other' and it is the largest one.

objectives.text: Read the cloud invoice in the south of the Cloud District (walk onto it, press [E])
Open the cloud dashboard on the east side of the district
Plug 2 Memory Leaks quietly inflating the bill — if the district is already clear, a portal round-trip restocks it

license_puzzle.name: Eleven Million Downloads, One Volunteer
license_puzzle.description: A stranger's weekend project holds your entire product together. Go and say thank you, then clear his path.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the Cloud District into the Open Source Wildlands
Find the Open Source Maintainer in the wildlands and thank him
Defeat a Legacy System — the grey slabs roaming the wildlands

three_dollars.name: Eleven Million Downloads, One Dave
three_dollars.description: The funding model of modern software is one man whose card occasionally expires. Look at the sponsor count, then look at the issue tracker, then decide how you feel about it.

objectives.text: Find the sponsor button in the east of the Open Source Wildlands (walk onto it, press [E])
Read open issue #4092 ('doesn't work') in the west of the wildlands
Clear 1 Legacy System off the maintainer's path

enterprise_ready.name: Just Add AI (Due Friday)
enterprise_ready.description: The SVP wants AI transformation by Friday. It's Thursday. He has never opened a terminal, only a keynote.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the Open Source Wildlands into Corporate Enterprise
Meet the SVP of AI Transformation Excellence on the office floor
Defeat the Enterprise Architect — the big one guarding the floor

mission_statement.name: Values Workshop (Mandatory, Optional)
mission_statement.description: The mission statement was written by a committee, approved by a second committee, and printed on the wall in a font nobody chose. Somebody has to read it out loud. To be offered it, ask the SVP to define requirements, then whether you can just buy a tool.

objectives.text: Read the mission statement on the west wall of Corporate Enterprise (walk onto it, press [E])
Clear 2 Scope Creeps that also attended the workshop
Report back to the SVP of AI Transformation Excellence on the office floor

scope_control.name: Scope Is A Verb Now
scope_control.description: Nobody added the extra work. It arrived. Four separate Scope Creeps are loose on the office floor and the Kanban board has a column called 'Almost Done' with nine cards in it.

objectives.text: Defeat 3 Scope Creeps drifting around Corporate Enterprise
Read the Kanban board on the office floor (walk onto it, press [E])

gpu_rush.name: Mine Your Own Business
gpu_rush.description: Acquire compute. Avoid thermal throttling. Question every choice that led you into a 94-degree room.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from Corporate Enterprise into the GPU Mines
Mine 50 compute — the glowing chunks across the mine floor
Plug 3 Memory Leaks drifting deeper in the mine

cooling_budget.name: The Cooling Budget Became A Rebrand
cooling_budget.description: There is a beautiful new logo and a room that is legally a hazard. The foreman wants the numbers written down by somebody who does not work here, so the report can say a name that isn't his.

objectives.text: Mine 30 more from the compute seams — the glowing chunks across the mine floor
Plug 2 Memory Leaks pooling near the vents — if the mine is already clear, a portal round-trip restocks it

thermal_shift.name: Thermal Headroom (There Is None)
thermal_shift.description: The foreman wants a second pair of eyes on the floor before the next shift. Rig 12 melted a hole in the concrete last week. There is a cone on it. The cone is in the asset register.

objectives.text: Inspect the mining rig in the GPU Mines (walk onto it, press [E])
Inspect the cooling fan on the far side of the mine
Plug 2 Memory Leaks while you're down there

production_down.name: Production Is Down (Nobody Deployed Anything)
production_down.description: PagerDuty is screaming, users are tweeting, and your manager is 'just checking in'. Bring everything.

objectives.text: Take the east portal from the GPU Mines into Production
Confront the Legacy Monolith — the enormous one at the heart of Production
Banish 2 Hallucinations (the confident, drifting ones lying to users)

all_quiet.name: Handover Notes: 'All Quiet'
all_quiet.description: The outgoing engineer wrote 'all quiet' at 08:59 and logged off at 09:00. There are two open incidents, one silenced alert, and a Post-it on the monitor that says 'don't restart 3'.

objectives.text: Read the on-call pager in the north of Production (walk onto it, press [E])
Read the incident runbook in the south-west — the step about Gerald
Banish 2 Hallucinations still telling users things that were never true

ship_dream_app.name: Deploy On A Friday
ship_dream_app.description: The reset is coming and the app is 'done enough', which has historically meant the same thing it means today.

objectives.text: Use the 'Dream App Terminal' on your desk in the apartment to prep the build
Travel east past Production into the Token Vault and claim the reserves
Back in the apartment, hit 'Deploy To Production' (the app must meet its ship requirements first)

vault_audit.name: Reconciling The Balance (Downward)
vault_audit.description: The vault does the subtraction between what you have and what the cheapest remaining upgrade costs, out loud, every single time you walk past it. Go and let it.

objectives.text: Travel east past Production into the Token Vault
Open the vault terminal in the north of the chamber (walk onto it, press [E])
Defeat 2 Rate Limiters guarding the reserves

prewritten_postmortem.name: The Postmortem Is Already Written
prewritten_postmortem.description: Incident language, applied in advance, with the euphemism intact and the truth in brackets. Everything you need is in this apartment: the whiteboard, the laptop, and the bed you are not going to use.

objectives.text: Read the whiteboard on the apartment's north wall (walk onto it, press [E])
Read the sticker-covered laptop beside the desk
Look at the bed in the apartment's south-east corner (walk onto it, press [E] — looking only)

fix_without_touching.name: Fix It Without Touching Anything
fix_without_touching.description: Management has declared a code freeze. Nobody has informed the bug.

objectives.text: Defeat 2 Null References in the Dependency District

junior_agent.name: The Agent Optimized The Database
junior_agent.description: Somebody gave an autonomous agent production credentials on a Friday. That somebody was you. It is 100% confident and would like to know if it can do more.

objectives.text: Find the Junior Agent wandering the API Bazaar and talk to it
Reach the 'Backup Server' in the Bazaar and interact with it

merge_conflict_hell.name: Merge Conflict From Hell
merge_conflict_hell.description: Two branches. One truth. You wrote both sides of this argument and you were wrong in each.

objectives.text: Defeat the Merge Conflict boss at the centre of the Stack Overflow Ruins

context_window_full.name: You Pasted The Whole Repo
context_window_full.description: It has read everything. It remembers you calling this 'just a prototype'. It brings that up.

objectives.text: Defeat THE INFINITE CONTEXT — the boss guarding the Token Vault, east of Production
